biggest_catch: The $25 tier requires your friend to open a CHECKING account, vehicle loan, or credit card (not just the $1 savings account); a personal loan, HSA, or youth savings account only earns the $10 tier - and the friend must submit the referral certificate within 5 business days of account opening or no bonus is paid to either party.
catches: Referrer must be a current CEFCU member in good standing; employees, volunteers, their immediate families, and household members are ineligible.
Friend must be a non-member who qualifies for CEFCU membership, opens a regular Savings account ($1 min) on or before 12/31/26, AND opens a qualifying account at the same time.
$25 tier qualifying accounts: Checking, Vehicle Loan, or Credit Card. $10 tier: Personal Loan, Health Savings Account, or (friend age 12 or younger) the Savings account.
Excluded: Insured Money Market, Club accounts, Hybrid HELOCs, Home Loans, UTMA, Rep Payee accounts, Certificates.
Official Referral Certificate (web form or paper) must be submitted at account opening or mailed within 5 business days - late = no bonus.
Cap: 3 Referral Bonuses paid to a Member, or $75, whichever is greater, per calendar year; one bonus per new Friend.
Bonuses deposited 4-6 weeks after the friend's account opening, via direct deposit to CEFCU Savings.
Bonus value is a taxable dividend reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Offer is limited-time (savings must open by 12/31/26) and subject to change.

steps: Fill out the Official Referral Certificate web form on cefcu.com (or the paper certificate's 'Referred By' section) with your and your friend's information.
Give the certificate to your friend; they open a CEFCU regular Savings account ($1+ min) AND a qualifying account (checking, vehicle loan, or credit card for the $25 tier) on or before 12/31/26.
Friend submits the completed certificate at account opening or mails it to CEFCU Marketing/Referral within 5 business days.
Both you and your friend receive the bonus ($25 or $10 tier) via direct deposit to CEFCU Savings within 4-6 weeks.
timing: Bonuses deposited 4-6 weeks following the friend's account opening.
